title: Unknotting the trefoil with a partner

numbered_results.description: Let T be a trefoil. Let P_m be the numerator closure of the rational tangle of fraction (104m+37)/104, with signature opposite in sign to that of T. For m = 2, 4 and every integer m >= 6, the knots P_m are pairwise distinct prime two-bridge knots with u(P_m) = 3 and 2 <= u(T # P_m) <= 3 < 4 = u(T) + u(P_m). The knot P_2 is 14a7385 up to mirror.

For every m in Theorem 1A.1, choose P_m with the chirality for the positive trefoil. Every nontrivial positive trefoil plumbing K satisfies u(K # P_m) <= u(K) + 2 < u(K) + u(P_m). This includes every nontrivial positive braid knot and, up to mirroring both summands, every nontrivial torus knot.

proof_notes.name: Three changes for the first partner
proof_notes.description: Figure 2 traces the three crossing changes for T # 14a7385. The independent replay constructs the three tangle replacements directly and checks the filled witness.

proof_notes.name: Uniform three-change upper bound
proof_notes.description: The geometric replay checks both augmented parity representatives, including the splitting sphere, final unlink and marked exterior identifications. The paper uses the peripheral maps to carry the three-change sequence through all specified fillings.

proof_notes.name: Lattice obstruction to two changes
proof_notes.description: The diagonal-lattice argument rules out u(P_m) = 2 for m = 4 and every integer m >= 6.

proof_notes.name: Correction-term obstruction at determinant 245
proof_notes.description: For P_2, exact rational calculations rule out the correction-term inequalities required by Owens's two-change obstruction.
